Name: Shenandoah Acres
Author: MidnightfireR
Description:
Shenandoah Acres is an All-in-One Farm Map designed for future multiplayer content.

Be sure to grab the companion SMAPI mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/756/]Shenandoah Library[/url] by Nishtra to enable all bonus features.


There are plenty of secrets to discover; try examining the pier behind your house.


How to install:

Unpack to Stardew/Content
Replace all

Start a new game and select the Riverlands Farm.
